Name: The Mothers Circle
Author: oNIGHTLUGA25
Description:
[i]An expansion for pregnancy and family life in Stardew Valley.[/i]
When your family is expecting a baby, Jodi invites you to the Stardrop Saloon. There, the Mothers’ Circle shares stories, helps you prepare for the baby, and remembers what you write in its notebook. After the birth, familiar faces stop by to see how your family is doing.
[heading]🌷 What’s included[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Four visible pregnancy stages[/b] over 14 in-game days for the farmer or supported spouses.[/*]
[*][b]Gatherings at the Saloon and home visits after the birth[/b], with choices that come up again in later scenes.[/*]
[*][b]An optional checkup with Harvey[/b] and a farmhouse renovation from Robin, including a bathroom and nursery.[/*]
[*][b]Maternity outfits and a blue spa swimsuit[/b] in Emily’s free clothing catalog. With Downtown Zuzu installed, you can also visit the [b]First Cuddle[/b] boutique.[/*]
[*][b]Optional guests[/b] from Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and Downtown Zuzu.[/*]
[/list][heading]💌 How to start[/heading]
Once you receive [b]Jodi’s letter[/b], visit the [b]Stardrop Saloon between noon and midnight[/b] while the pregnancy is active. For [b]Harvey’s checkup[/b], wait for his letter and visit the [b]clinic next to Pierre’s between 9 AM and 2 PM[/b].
[heading]🤝 Playing in co-op[/heading]
In [b]3.5.4[/b], available players can watch story cutscenes together. Choices, letters, and rewards stay with the player who triggered the scene. All players should install the latest 3.5.4 download. If you already have an earlier copy with the same version number, download it again for the co-op fixes.
Shared cutscenes passed simulated checks. We’d love to hear how they work on your farm in a live co-op session.
[heading]📦 Installation[/heading]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b], [b]SMAPI 4.1.5+[/b], and [b]Content Patcher 2.0+[/b]. Choose [b]one[/b] download in [b]English[/b], [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], or [b]Spanish[/b] and extract it into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder. If you’re updating, replace the entire
[code]The Mothers Circle[/code]folder. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55497?tab=files]Download the mod on Nexus Mods[/url]
[heading]💬 Support and updates[/heading]
Join [b]The Valley Workshop[/b] for mod updates, installation help, and bug reports. If a scene doesn’t start, tell us which letter you received, where you went, what time it was in-game, and whether you were playing solo or co-op. Include your SMAPI log if you can. [url=https://discord.gg/fQFT2NeQ6E]Join the Discord[/url]
[heading]🤍 Credits and permissions[/heading]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley and its base sprites, cptnmatruz for the [i]Haley’s Pregnancy[/i] cutscene inspiration, and the Downtown Zuzu team for the storefront. The mod was created in Brazil with AI assistance for outfits, translations, packaging, and promotional art.
Personal and co-op play are welcome. Please ask permission before distributing translations, forks, or modified versions, or reusing original assets. Credit the original mod if you receive permission. Reuploads, ports, and monetization or Donation Points from derivative uploads are prohibited. Third-party assets follow their creators’ permissions.
